episodes.title: What is 2 Hour Learning? A Brief Overview of our model and schools
episodes.youtubeDescription: We all know that education is not doing well. Not in the US at least. And something has to change. I think that is something we all agree on. From there, is where many people have many opinions. It's my opinion that the teacher in front of the classroom model is broken. Not because teachers are bad, or lazy, or that they don't care, but simply because they are being asked to do the impossible. They can't teach 25-30 students at varying levels and it is the fundamental flaw with our system. It's worked for many years prior because students were mostly at the same pace, and students tended to be self motivated to learn. In our technology driven world, students are realizing that school is less and less relevant to them and their future. Add in family/parental issues and technology addiction and you have a recipe for disaster in our schools. And the results are exactly that. Disastrous. Enter AI tutors. AI Apps can meet each student exactly where they are-at the pace and level they need.
